title: Sausage Mash Pie
ingredients: 8 reduced-fat pork sausages, each sliced into 6
390g can green lentils, drained and rinsed
700g white potatoes (3–4), peeled and cut into chunks
400g can butter beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Fry onions gently in cooking spray for ~6 minutes. Add garlic; stir-fry 30 seconds. Add sausage pieces; fry until browned.
Add stock, lentils, tomato purée, thyme and brown sauce; season; simmer gently.
Meanwhile, boil potato chunks for 10 minutes; add butter beans; simmer another 10 minutes. Drain; mash with milk until smooth; season.
Decant sausage mixture into an ovenproof dish; spread mash evenly over top; rough up with a fork; spray with cooking spray.
Bake 25–30 minutes until golden brown with crispy edges.
notes: Add leeks, celery, diced carrots or sweet potato to the sauce for extra veg.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
